title: مدرسة فقيرة وجامعة بعيدة.. خريطة الفجوة التعليمية في فرنسا
body: تتناول حلقة "المخبر الاقتصادي" غضب طلاب فرنسا من زاوية أبعد من الاحتجاجات نفسها. فالقصة لا تبدأ في الشارع، بل داخل فصل بلا معلم، وحافلة لا تنتظر، ومقعد جامعي قد يكون موجودا لكنه بعيد عن قدرة الطالب.

title: الذهب والدولار يتراجعان والنفط يتباين وسط ترقب بيانات التضخم الأمريكية

title: إيران مباشر.. بلاغ عن إصابة سفينة في هرمز وترمب يتحدث عن "قرار قريب"
body: قال الرئيس الأمريكي دونالد ترمب إن واشنطن ستتخذ قرارا بشأن إيران "قريبا جدا"، فيما نفى مسؤول بالبيت الأبيض للجزيرة صحة المعلومات بشأن احتمال شن هجوم أمريكي عليها قبل الانتخابات النصفية.

title: در یمن جنگی با پیامدهای جهانی در جریان است

body: TEHRAN — “I don’t have a single B on my report card. Is this the respect I get?” The girl standing at the school gate was crying, and the officials in front of her did not move. “Have I ever done anything wrong? And now you’re telling me I can’t enter the school. Why should I have to give up my religion?”

title: Trump targets anti-war Muslim congresswoman three weeks before midterms
body: TEHRAN — U.S. federal agents with Homeland Security Investigations executed a search warrant early Monday morning at the Washington residence of Representative Ilhan Omar. Law enforcement personnel blocked off the surrounding street and removed multiple boxes labeled as “seized evidence” from the premises.

title: Sophocles’ “Antigone” on stage in Mahallat
body: TEHRAN – The play “Antigone” by Sophocles is being performed at the Artists Forum in Mahallat, Markazi Province.

title: Tehran Symphony Orchestra to perform “In the Italian Style” concert
body: TEHRAN- The Tehran Symphony Orchestra, conducted by Nasir Heidarian and featuring cellist Majid Esmaeili as soloist, will present a concert titled “In the Italian Style” at Tehran’s Vahdat Hall on October 20.

title: Restored “Bashu, the Little Stranger” to go on screen in Montreal
body: TEHRAN- A restored 4K version of the late Iranian filmmaker Bahram Beyzaie’s acclaimed film “Bashu, the Little Stranger” will be screened at Cinéma Moderne in Montreal, Canada, on Wednesday evening.

title: Trump's credibility under question
body: Khorasan argued that Trump's contradictory behavior has weakened his credibility. Pro-Israel circles in Washington portray Trump's unpredictability as a sign of strength, claiming that Iran should always remain uncertain about his next move.

title: Iran, Azerbaijan seek to translate bilateral agreements into concrete action
body: TEHRAN — Iranian Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni has underscored Tehran’s commitment to strengthening ties with Azerbaijan, implementing bilateral agreements and expanding cooperation across a broad range of areas of mutual interest.

title: Iran has reached developed nations’ level in nuclear science, says AEOI chief
body: TEHRAN — Iran has attained a level of nuclear science and technology comparable to that of developed countries and is now manufacturing domestically the equipment and systems required by its national industries, Vice President and Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (AEOI) chief Mohammad Eslami said on Tuesday.

title: Iran develops countermeasures against Starlink
body: TEHRAN — Iran has developed technical capabilities to identify and disrupt unauthorized Starlink satellite internet terminals, while intensifying its efforts through international regulatory channels to compel the service to comply with telecommunications rules governing its operations inside Iranian territory.

title: Iran warns US against renewed military action, stresses readiness for diplomacy and defense
body: TEHRAN — Iran has warned the United States against any renewed military action, saying the consequences would extend beyond the region, while reaffirming its readiness to pursue diplomacy on the basis of realistic proposals and mutual respect for commitments.

title: IRGC forces dismantle kidnapping cell in southeastern Iran
body: TEHRAN- Iran’s Islamic Revolution Guard Corps (IRGC) has dismantled an armed kidnapping cell linked to a terrorist group in Sistan-Baluchestan Province, rescuing an engineer abducted a day earlier and killing five members of the group, according to the IRGC’s Quds Headquarters.

title: Iran pursues fate of pilots in Qatar, vows justice for Minab school victims
body: TEHRAN — Iran is pursuing diplomatic and legal efforts to protect its national interests, determine the status of Iranian pilots in Qatar and secure justice for the victims of the February 28 attack on a primary school in Minab, government spokesperson Fatemeh Mohajerani said on Tuesday.

title: London Bombs, London Blames
body: TEHRAN – Iran's Foreign Ministry has strongly condemned Britain's accusation linking Tehran to an alleged security incident at RAF Fairford air base, dismissing it as an ugly plot designed to fuel Iranophobia and evade accountability for London's direct participation in the ongoing American-Zionist military aggression against the Iranian nation.
